description: A silhouetted figure climbs a flagpole at night, topped by a white-triangled flag with a red star and a gold bird, in green, yellow, red and black stripes. Below, a dense crowd of dark silhouettes raises fists and arms under stadium floodlights, with smoke or haze drifting and a small flag visible far to the right. The style is a painterly night scene with no visible text.
